heading: Overview
text: Feature-based Metabolite Set Enrichment Analysis untargeted metabolomics, MS1 annotation pathway interpretation.featureMSEA (Feature-based Metabolite Set Enrichment Analysis) powerful method interpreting metabolomics data. Unlike conventional -representation analysis, featureMSEA operates directly metabolic features — including unannotated ones — identify enriched metabolic pathways without requiring hard annotation cutoff.

heading: What is featureMSEA?
text: featureMSEA extends classic Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) framework metabolomics. ranks detected metabolic features signal statistic (e.g., fold-change × significance) evaluates whether features assigned given pathway non-randomly distributed toward top bottom ranked list.Key advantages:strict annotation cutoff required pathway-level analysis.Supports KEGG, HMDB, iMETpD, Reactome, WikiPathways workflows.Add optional AI-guided biological review enriched pathways.Works unannotated features — strict annotation cutoff requiredSupports multiple pathway databases: KEGG, HMDB, iMETpD, Reactome, WikiPathwaysIntegrates LLM-based biological evaluation AI-assisted interpretationFully integrated TidyMass Shiny web interface

heading: 1 Installation
text: featureMSEA available standalone R package also integrated TidyMass Shiny web application. Choose option best fits workflow.

heading: 1.1 Option A — TidyMass Shiny (recommended)
text: easiest way run featureMSEA TidyMass Shiny interface, provides point--click workflow without R coding.Access online version:Visit https://tidymassshiny.jaspershenlab.com — installation needed.Run locally:Navigate fMSEA Analysis module Tidymass Shiny Toolkits dropdown.
code:
# Install TidyMass and dependencies
remotes::install_gitlab("tidymass/tidymass")

# Install TidyMass Shiny
remotes::install_github("tidymass/tidymass_shiny")

# Launch
library(tidymass)
library(tidymassshiny)
run_tidymass_shiny()

Figure 3.1: LLM evaluation interface

heading: 3.1.1 Matrix Relevance Analysis
text: Evaluates reliably metabolites detected biological matrix expected reflect pathway activity.Input: Biological matrix type (e.g., "urine", "plasma", "serum", "blood", "feces")Output: Per-pathway confidence score indicating matrix-pathway reliability

heading: 3.1.2 Literature Relevance Analysis
text: Searches PubMed scores enriched pathway based published evidence specific research context.Input: Research topic (e.g., "type 2 diabetes", "colorectal cancer", "pregnancy")Output: Per-pathway literature support score summarized evidence

heading: 3.2 API configuration
text: featureMSEA supports two LLM providers:Enter API key API Key field running. Keys never stored transmitted beyond LLM provider.Caution: LLM outputs probabilistic. Always verify AI-generated biological interpretations primary literature. Use module guide hypothesis generation, replace domain expertise.
